title: Toxic language detection: a systematic review of Arabic datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic review and evaluation of Arabic datasets specifically annotated for misogyny, sexism, and gender-based attacks (e.g., ArMI, Let-Mi, ArMIS).
Systematic review of datasets categorized for religious hate speech, sectarianism, anti-Islamic sentiment, and religious extremism/radicalism.
Analysis of datasets specifically annotated for anti-refugee and migrant hate speech, such as texts targeting African refugees in Algeria.
Review of datasets with fine-grained hate speech annotations that specify race and ethnicity as targets, including datasets used to probe LLMs for racial stereotypes using cloze statements.
